column5: PSF-2.0, with the licences of the code it includes in /usr/local/lib/python3.12/LICENSE.txt; built by Docker's official python:3.12-slim image and linked against Debian packages of this list
MIT; its vendored certifi is MPL-2.0 and is shipped as its own source files
BSD-3-Clause AND 0BSD AND MIT AND Zlib AND CC0-1.0
BSD-3-Clause, with LAPACK (BSD-3-Clause-Open-MPI) and GCC's libgfortran statically linked (GPL-3.0-or-later WITH GCC-exception-3.1, which permits this without offering its source)
MIT-CMU, with raqm (MIT) and fribidi-shim (MIT-CMU) built in; FriBiDi is loaded at run time when present and is not shipped
FTL (FreeType offers FTL or GPL-2.0-or-later; Pillow takes FTL)
GPL-2.0-or-later; a static binary that includes Debian 13's glibc (LGPL-2.1-or-later; its source is this bundle's glibc) and libgcc (GPL-3.0-or-later WITH GCC-exception-3.1)
MIT (mcbench-lite's repository); statically linked with musl (MIT), Rust's standard library (MIT OR Apache-2.0) and 44 crates under MIT, Apache-2.0, Zlib, Unicode-3.0 or Unlicense
